title: UiKit attestation
description: The answer to one claim a contract makes about itself, plus who or what established it. "failed" (looked at, does not hold) and "unknown" (nobody looked) are different answers and may not collapse into one. `by` is optional and names a role, a suite or a primitive's own behaviour - never a person: a "verified" nothing attributes is a claim a later reader cannot re-check.

by.description: What established the outcome: a test suite, a review, the behaviour the primitive underneath already guarantees. A role or an artifact, not a person.
